entity_resolution.strongest_supported_conclusion: SBIC East, SBIC Central and SBIC West are three distinct regional Japanese investment-development companies. They are not SBI Holdings, Inc. or alternate names for it. The official regional profiles describe the three as sister companies; SBI Holdings has a separate corporate profile, name, establishment date and group-control business description.
entity_resolution.ownership_claim_boundary: The official profile pages reviewed do not identify the regional SBIC companies as SBI Holdings subsidiaries. A complete named shareholder-register and beneficial-ownership audit was not performed, so this addendum does not claim that no SBI-affiliated entity could appear anywhere in any regional shareholder register.
entity_resolution.academic_acronym_collision: SBIC also means Social Bias Inference Corpus in AI research; that corpus is unrelated to the Japanese regional companies.
